sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: What AI can and cannot do in diagnosis
passage.text: Systems trained on medical images can now detect certain cancers at least as accurately as specialist radiologists. Headlines often stop there. In practice the interesting questions begin afterwards. A model is calibrated on the population it was trained on; move it to a hospital with different equipment and its accuracy may fall sharply. It also reports a probability, not a reason, and clinicians are understandably reluctant to act on a number they cannot interrogate. The most promising deployments therefore place the model beside the doctor rather than in place of the doctor, using it to sort urgent cases and to flag images that deserve a second look.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: The most promising deployments therefore place the model beside the doctor rather than in place of the doctor, using it to sort urgent cases and to flag images that deserve a second look.

answer.text: 因此，最有前景的部署方式是把模型放在医生身边、而非取代医生，用它来分拣急症病例，并标记出值得复查的影像。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 160 words on the following topic: AI systems can read medical images as accurately as specialists. Discuss what this can and cannot replace.

answer.text: AI systems now match specialist radiologists in detecting some cancers, and the temptation to describe this as a replacement is strong. It is also premature. A model's accuracy depends on the population and equipment it was trained on; move it to a different hospital and performance may drop. More importantly, a model outputs a probability, not a reason, and a clinician cannot interrogate a number. The sensible division of labour is therefore complementary. The model sorts urgent cases and flags images for review, while the doctor explains, decides, and takes responsibility. Used this way, AI shortens the queue without asking patients to trust a black box.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：写成「AI 将取代医生」或「AI 完全无用」的两极判断，缺少「辅助而非替代」的中间立场。

framework.title: 图画作文
steps: 首段：一句点图（As is vividly depicted…），再写 2 句细节
二段：一句点寓意，再展开因果或举例
三段：一句总结 + 一句建议/展望
用具体名词替换万能词（people→students/employees）
framework.trap: 只描述图画不解释寓意，二段空洞

walkthrough.solution: AI systems now match specialist radiologists in detecting some cancers, and the temptation to describe this as a replacement is strong. It is also premature. A model's accuracy depends on the population and equipment it was trained on; move it to a different hospital and performance may drop. More importantly, a model outputs a probability, not a reason, and a clinician cannot interrogate a number. The sensible division of labour is therefore complementary. The model sorts urgent cases and flags images for review, while the doctor explains, decides, and takes responsibility. Used this way, AI shortens the queue without asking patients to trust a black box.
